title: Keep custody validation within the canonical ledger capacity
outcome: Custody admission validates supported retained exchange histories without double-charging repeated canonical reads, while preserving bounded reads and all custody integrity refusals.
acceptance: Custody validation accepts valid retained histories within the canonical ledger's admitted record and byte limits without charging repeated reads as additional distinct canonical objects; malformed, missing, conflicting, and genuinely excessive history remains refused.
A behavioral regression demonstrates the previous custody budget failure on a valid admitted history and passes with the correction, alongside relevant custody and keyed-reader regression coverage.

completion.summary: Corrected the shared exchange read budget to count distinct canonical objects once while revalidating every read. Valid near-capacity custody history and exact audit replay now pass; unchanged count/byte/per-record limits and integrity refusals remain covered.
